slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck, and did not explicitly mark it as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No truck capacity constraint is relevant; the model ignores the stated limit that each truck can carry up to 2 containers.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the truck capacity limit, yet its READY_TO_MODEL summary states there are no route capacities or other constraints and omits the truck capacity fact.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2 truck capacity, which does not affect the core transportation cost model or optimal objective value. The agent resolved the key supply/leftover interpretation before stopping.

summary: The agent handled the main transportation structure well and confirmed the critical supply-surplus treatment, but it never asked about the P2 truck capacity limit and silently omitted it from the final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
